summary: Flat crest of a residential street where cars park; homes 21-22 m away.
reasons: Homes 21-22 m away on both sides

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 21 m (at 71 m) and 22 m (at 59 m); more houses 13-15 m off at the ends of the stretch. Homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along both kerbs, so a van can pull in without blocking.
drivers.traffic: Local street; the motorway on the west is well away, noise only.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along the kerb in the imagery, so a van is not out of place.

flags: Steep either side of the crest: max 23%, mean 7.7%
sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy on both sides; partial shade, mostly from the east.

best_section.where: Crest of Newcomen Street, west kerb, between the two bends
